title: nextflow-run-happy-region pipeline parameters
description: Benchmark query VCFs against truth VCFs with hap.py over a set of regions, and optionally ask an LLM agent to explain false negatives.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet describing the truth and query VCFs for each sample.
input.help_text: CSV with a header row and columns: sample_id, truth_vcf, truth_index, query_vcf, query_index, and optionally query_bam, query_bam_index. The BAM columns are only needed with --explain_fn; samples without them are skipped by the false-negative explanation step. Paths may be local or s3://.

region_bed.description: BED file restricting the regions compared by hap.py.

restrict_regions.description: Restrict the hap.py comparison to the BED regions (hap.py -T).
restrict_regions.help_text: When true, hap.py is run with -T and -f set to region_bed, so only records inside the regions are read, compared and written. When false, only -f is used: hap.py compares the whole genome and labels query calls outside the BED as UNK. Counts inside the regions are normally the same either way (variants at region edges can differ slightly, because nearby context outside the BED is dropped); true is much faster and gives a much smaller output VCF.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. Use an absolute path (e.g. s3://...) when running on cloud infrastructure.

reference_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_options.description: Reference FASTA used by hap.py and for gathering false-negative evidence.

ref.description: Reference genome FASTA. Must match the build of the truth and query VCFs.

ref_index.description: samtools faidx index (.fai) for the reference FASTA.

fn_explain_options.title: False-negative explanation options
fn_explain_options.description: Optional LLM agent step that explains why variants were missed.

explain_fn.description: Ask an LLM agent (Claude Sonnet 4.6) to explain false negatives.
explain_fn.help_text: Requires query_bam and query_bam_index columns in the samplesheet, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in the launch environment (on Seqera Platform, store it as a secret).

max_fn.description: Maximum number of false negatives explained per sample (one LLM call each).

fn_window.description: Bases of context gathered either side of each false negative.

fp_explain_options.title: False-positive explanation options
fp_explain_options.description: Optional LLM agent step that explains why query calls did not match the truth set.

explain_fp.description: Ask an LLM agent (Claude Sonnet 4.6) to explain false positives.
explain_fp.help_text: Requires query_bam and query_bam_index columns in the samplesheet, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in the launch environment (on Seqera Platform, store it as a secret). Can be combined with --explain_fn.

max_fp.description: Maximum number of false positives explained per sample (one LLM call each).

fp_window.description: Bases of context gathered either side of each false positive.
